text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that fried chicken was delicious♪ 
Digging in with your bare hands! Eating it 
so hearty is just—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You over there, do not drink that water!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The water in that glass is for rinsing 
your fingertips. Considering hygiene—

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
Your Highness...! I believe that glass is 
for drinking water, not a finger bowl.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
! How could I... My sincerest apologies. I 
caused you trouble due to my own lack of 
knowledge...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Fine Motion reflected on her 
misunderstanding...
